title: On the maximal index of $C_4^-$-free unbalanced signed graphs of prescribed size
summary: The extremal problem of determining the graphs with maximum spectral radius among all graphs with a prescribed number of edges was resolved by Rowlinson [Linear Algebra Appl. 110 (1988) 43--53]. A signed graph $Γ=(G,σ)$ is called $C_k^-$-free if it contains no negative $k$-cycle as a signed subgraph. The index of a signed graph is defined as the largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix. This paper addresses the maximization of the index of unbalanced signed graphs. For signed graphs of a prescribed order, Wang and Lin [Discrete Appl.
